definitionZh: 无限滚动组件是一个在滚动时加载更多项目的容器。当您需要显示未知但大量的项目时，它非常有用。
sourceDefinition: The Infinite scroll component is a container that loads more items when scrolling. It is useful when you need to display an unknown but large number of items.
